panels.title: UX Responsiveness
panels.description: Composite score (0-100) for user-visible responsiveness: content freshness, render smoothness, command ack, and reliability counters. Excludes full agent turn duration because long turns can be productive work.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH session_stats AS (
  SELECT
    session_id,
    MIN(ts_ms) AS first_ts,
    AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'app.timeline_jank' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.jank_pct') END) AS jank,
    AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'app.fresh_content_lag' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END) AS lag,
    SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'app.message_queue_stale_drop' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS drops,
    SUM(CASE WHEN name IN ('app.message_queue_start_miss', 'app.media_playback_error') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures,
    AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'app.message_queue_ack' AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'ok' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END) AS ack,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN name = 'app.timeline_apply' AND json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') > 50 THEN 1 END) AS REAL) /
      MAX(1, COUNT(CASE WHEN name = 'app.timeline_apply' THEN 1 END)) * 100 AS hitch_pct,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN name = 'app.catchup' AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.result') = 'ring_miss' THEN 1 END) AS ring_misses,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN name = 'app.ttft' THEN 1 END) AS turns
  FROM events
  WHERE name IN ('app.timeline_jank', 'app.fresh_content_lag', 'app.message_queue_stale_drop', 'app.message_queue_start_miss', 'app.media_playback_error', 'app.message_queue_ack', 'app.timeline_apply', 'app.catchup', 'app.ttft')
    AND session_id IS NOT NULL AND session_id != ''
    AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  GROUP BY session_id
  HAVING turns >= 3
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(100.0
  - MIN(25, MAX(0, (COALESCE(jank, 0) - 5) * 25.0 / 25))
  - MIN(15, MAX(0, (hitch_pct - 2) * 15.0 / 13))
  - MIN(20, MAX(0, (COALESCE(lag, 1000) - 300) * 20.0 / 2700))
  - MIN(10, MAX(0, (COALESCE(ack, 300) - 300) * 10.0 / 1700))
  - MIN(25, drops * 5.0)
  - MIN(15, failures * 5.0)
  - MIN(5, ring_misses * 5.0)), 0) AS value
FROM session_stats

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.result'), 'unknown') AS result,
  COUNT(*) AS samples,
  ROUND(AVG(json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms')), 1) AS avg_ms,
  ROUND(MIN(json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms')), 1) AS min_ms,
  ROUND(MAX(json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms')), 1) AS max_ms,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') > 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS over_500ms_pct
FROM events
WHERE name = 'app.catchup'
  AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
GROUP BY result
ORDER BY samples DESC

panels.title: UX Responsiveness Trend
panels.description: Daily average UX responsiveness score. This excludes full agent turn duration; long turns are tracked as workload/progress.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH session_stats AS (
  SELECT
    session_id,
    MIN(ts_ms) AS first_ts,
    AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'app.timeline_jank' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.jank_pct') END) AS jank,
    AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'app.fresh_content_lag' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END) AS lag,
    SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'app.message_queue_stale_drop' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS drops,
    SUM(CASE WHEN name IN ('app.message_queue_start_miss', 'app.media_playback_error') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures,
    AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'app.message_queue_ack' AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'ok' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END) AS ack,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN name = 'app.timeline_apply' AND json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') > 50 THEN 1 END) AS REAL) /
      MAX(1, COUNT(CASE WHEN name = 'app.timeline_apply' THEN 1 END)) * 100 AS hitch_pct,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN name = 'app.catchup' AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.result') = 'ring_miss' THEN 1 END) AS ring_misses,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN name = 'app.ttft' THEN 1 END) AS turns
  FROM events
  WHERE name IN ('app.timeline_jank', 'app.fresh_content_lag', 'app.message_queue_stale_drop', 'app.message_queue_start_miss', 'app.media_playback_error', 'app.message_queue_ack', 'app.timeline_apply', 'app.catchup', 'app.ttft')
    AND session_id IS NOT NULL AND session_id != ''
    AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  GROUP BY session_id
  HAVING turns >= 3
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    first_ts / 1000 AS ts,
    100.0
  - MIN(25, MAX(0, (COALESCE(jank, 0) - 5) * 25.0 / 25))
  - MIN(15, MAX(0, (hitch_pct - 2) * 15.0 / 13))
  - MIN(20, MAX(0, (COALESCE(lag, 1000) - 300) * 20.0 / 2700))
  - MIN(10, MAX(0, (COALESCE(ack, 300) - 300) * 10.0 / 1700))
  - MIN(25, drops * 5.0)
  - MIN(15, failures * 5.0)
  - MIN(5, ring_misses * 5.0) AS score
  FROM session_stats
)
SELECT ts AS time, ROUND(score, 0) AS quality_score
FROM scored
ORDER BY ts

panels.title: UX Responsiveness Breakdown
panels.description: Per-session responsiveness breakdown. Worst sessions first. Long agent work duration is intentionally not part of this score.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH session_stats AS (
  SELECT
    session_id,
    MIN(ts_ms) AS first_ts,
    AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'app.timeline_jank' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.jank_pct') END) AS jank,
    AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'app.fresh_content_lag' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END) AS lag,
    SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'app.message_queue_stale_drop' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS drops,
    SUM(CASE WHEN name IN ('app.message_queue_start_miss', 'app.media_playback_error') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures,
    AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'app.message_queue_ack' AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'ok' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END) AS ack,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN name = 'app.timeline_apply' AND json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') > 50 THEN 1 END) AS REAL) /
      MAX(1, COUNT(CASE WHEN name = 'app.timeline_apply' THEN 1 END)) * 100 AS hitch_pct,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN name = 'app.catchup' AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.result') = 'ring_miss' THEN 1 END) AS ring_misses,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN name = 'app.ttft' THEN 1 END) AS turns
  FROM events
  WHERE name IN ('app.timeline_jank', 'app.fresh_content_lag', 'app.message_queue_stale_drop', 'app.message_queue_start_miss', 'app.media_playback_error', 'app.message_queue_ack', 'app.timeline_apply', 'app.catchup', 'app.ttft')
    AND session_id IS NOT NULL AND session_id != ''
    AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  GROUP BY session_id
  HAVING turns >= 3
)

  session_id,
  turns,
  ROUND(COALESCE(jank, 0), 1) AS jank_pct,
  ROUND(hitch_pct, 1) AS hitch_pct,
  ROUND(COALESCE(lag, 1000)) AS lag_ms,
  ROUND(COALESCE(ack, 300)) AS ack_ms,
  drops AS stale_drops,
  failures,
  ROUND(100.0
  - MIN(25, MAX(0, (COALESCE(jank, 0) - 5) * 25.0 / 25))
  - MIN(15, MAX(0, (hitch_pct - 2) * 15.0 / 13))
  - MIN(20, MAX(0, (COALESCE(lag, 1000) - 300) * 20.0 / 2700))
  - MIN(10, MAX(0, (COALESCE(ack, 300) - 300) * 10.0 / 1700))
  - MIN(25, drops * 5.0)
  - MIN(15, failures * 5.0)
  - MIN(5, ring_misses * 5.0), 0) AS score

panels.title: Memory warnings and stalls by screen
panels.description: app.memory_warning, app.main_thread_stall_detected, and app.main_thread_stall_recovered grouped by screen. avg_freed_mb is footprint_before_mb minus footprint_after_mb.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.screen')), ''), '(untagged)') AS screen,
  SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'app.memory_warning' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS memory_warnings,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'app.memory_warning' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.footprint_before_mb') END), 0) AS max_footprint_before_mb,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN name = 'app.memory_warning' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.footprint_before_mb') - json_extract(fields_json, '$.footprint_after_mb') END), 0) AS avg_freed_mb,
  SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'app.main_thread_stall_detected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stalls_detected,
  SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'app.main_thread_stall_recovered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stalls_recovered,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN name = 'app.main_thread_stall_recovered' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END), 0) AS max_stall_ms
FROM events
WHERE name IN ('app.memory_warning', 'app.main_thread_stall_detected', 'app.main_thread_stall_recovered')
  AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
GROUP BY screen
ORDER BY memory_warnings DESC, stalls_detected DESC
LIMIT 40

panels.description: 10s device samples grouped by the screen, stream_state, agents, and voice tags. cpu_core_min sums each sample's percent-of-one-core over its 10s window, in core-minutes, so it ranks where steady CPU cost goes.

targets.rawQueryText:

  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.screen')), ''), '(untagged)') AS screen,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.stream_state')), ''), '-') AS stream_state,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.agents')), ''), '-') AS agents,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.voice')), ''), '-') AS voice,
  COUNT(json_extract(fields_json, '$.cpu_pct')) AS samples,
  ROUND(AVG(json_extract(fields_json, '$.cpu_pct')), 1) AS cpu_avg_pct,
  ROUND(MAX(json_extract(fields_json, '$.cpu_pct')), 1) AS cpu_max_pct,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(json_extract(fields_json, '$.cpu_pct'), 0)) / 600.0, 1) AS cpu_core_min,
  ROUND(AVG(json_extract(fields_json, '$.memory_mb')), 0) AS mem_avg_mb,
  ROUND(MAX(json_extract(fields_json, '$.memory_mb')), 0) AS mem_max_mb
FROM events
WHERE name = 'app.device_resources'
  AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
GROUP BY screen, stream_state, agents, voice
ORDER BY cpu_core_min DESC
LIMIT 40

panels.description: app.command send_ms and roundtrip_ms, and app.command_resolve_lag lag_ms, as one row per command and phase. Percentiles are nearest-rank. Successful get_queue calls can be omitted, so this is not command volume. error_pct is status=error.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH samples AS (
  SELECT json_extract(tags_json, '$.command') AS command, 'send' AS phase, json_extract(fields_json, '$.send_ms') AS value, json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') AS status
  FROM events
  WHERE name = 'app.command' AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  UNION ALL
  SELECT json_extract(tags_json, '$.command'), 'roundtrip', json_extract(fields_json, '$.roundtrip_ms'), json_extract(tags_json, '$.status')
  FROM events
  WHERE name = 'app.command' AND json_extract(fields_json, '$.roundtrip_ms') IS NOT NULL AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  UNION ALL
  SELECT json_extract(tags_json, '$.command'), 'resolve_lag', json_extract(fields_json, '$.lag_ms'), json_extract(tags_json, '$.status')
  FROM events
  WHERE name = 'app.command_resolve_lag' AND ts_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(command, '?') AS command,
    phase,
    value,
    COALESCE(status, '') AS status,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY phase, COALESCE(command, '?') ORDER BY value) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY phase, COALESCE(command, '?')) AS n
  FROM samples
)
SELECT
  command,
  phase,
  n AS samples,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = ((n * 50 + 99) / 100) THEN value END), 1) AS p50_ms,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = ((n * 90 + 99) / 100) THEN value END), 1) AS p90_ms,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = ((n * 99 + 99) / 100) THEN value END), 1) AS p99_ms,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / n, 1) AS error_pct
FROM ranked
GROUP BY command, phase, n
ORDER BY samples DESC
